summary: Backend-only independent verification completed against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Core requested flows passed: owner captcha login/admin exchange, admin order logs, per-user activity dossier, livescores, full odds board, single and combo bets, my-bets, cashout, repeated-cashout rejection, concurrent-cashout smoke, and notification_service startup import. Pytest result: 9 passed, 3 failed; the failures are auth-security requirements (no httpOnly login cookie, wildcard CORS, no dashboard-login brute-force lockout).

critical.issue: Successful login returns the JWT only in JSON and sends no access_token httpOnly cookie. Verified Set-Cookie was empty. This leaves the application dependent on script-accessible token storage and does not meet the requested auth hardening check.

A preflight from https://example-evil.test returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * while the app config enables allow_credentials=True. CORS_ORIGINS is '*' in backend/.env rather than an explicit trusted frontend origin.
No brute-force lockout is implemented for regular dashboard login. Six consecutive invalid attempts with fresh valid captchas all returned 401; the sixth should have returned 429 after five failures.

Code review found that payout odds are trusted directly from the client payload. The endpoint only checks whether a match is suspended and never compares submitted market/selection/odds with server-side match_odds/defaults, so an authenticated user can submit inflated odds (up to 99x) and create an illegitimate potential payout.

minor.issue: The activity dossier returns orders, transactions, number rentals, live subscriptions, and live checks, but no sports bets array. This leaves the owner's stated requirement to inspect each user's sports-bet history incomplete, even though the explicitly listed response keys passed.

action_items: Derive bet odds server-side from match_id + market + selection and reject unknown or stale client values; do not calculate payouts from client-supplied odds.
Set secure httpOnly authentication cookie(s) on successful login and keep Bearer support only if intentionally required.
Replace wildcard CORS with explicit trusted frontend origin(s) when credentials are enabled.
Add persistent per-IP + identifier login-attempt tracking with a 429 lockout after five failures and clear it after successful login.
Include the user's sports bets in /api/admin/user-activity/{user_id} and render them in the admin history drill-down.
Retest auth security and sports-bet tamper resistance after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4017-4023 multiplies BetSelection.odds supplied by the requester instead of resolving authoritative odds from DEFAULT_MARKETS/match_odds; this is a direct financial-integrity vulnerability.
auth_and_chat.py:414-419 returns a token body but never accepts a Response or calls set_cookie.
auth_and_chat.py:422-441 has no failed-attempt persistence or lockout logic for normal login.
server.py:6696-6702 combines allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*'; configure explicit trusted origins.
server.py:2522-2567 does not query db.bets, so sports-bet history is absent from the admin user dossier.

server.py:4072-4081 ignores the matched/modified count of the conditional cashout update before inserting the refund transaction. The 5-way concurrency smoke passed, but checking the update result is still necessary to make double-refund prevention atomic under higher concurrency or multiple workers.

success_rate.backend: 75% overall (9/12); 100% for the explicitly requested core admin/sports/startup flows, 0/3 for additional required auth-hardening checks

seed_data_creation: Created five $0.10 TEST sports bets across two pytest runs (single, combo, and concurrency cases), exercised cashout, then deleted all five bet documents and all ten associated stake/cashout transactions directly from the test database. Net persistent wallet impact was removed with transaction cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_34_admin_sports.py against the external URL. Core flows currently pass. The three expected failures are httpOnly login cookie, explicit-origin credentialed CORS, and lockout after five invalid dashboard logins. Add a negative sports test that submits 99x odds and expects rejection/server-normalization once authoritative odds validation is implemented.
rca_of_the_issue: Admin order/activity and sports E2E implementations are operational. Remaining auth failures stem from token-body-only login, wildcard CORS configuration, and regular credential verification lacking attempt tracking. The sports financial-integrity issue stems from treating requester-supplied odds as authoritative when calculating combined_odds and potential_win.
